name: Phoenixfire Leather Armor
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot: chest; Price: 30,000 gp, Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This dull black masterwork leather armor is embossed with the image of a phoenix with its wings flared. The armor provides fire resistance 5. When the wearer suffers a critical hit from an opponent within 5 ft., the armor unleashes a flash of fire at the assailant, inflicting 2d6 points of fire damage (Reflex DC 15 for half damage). Last, if the wearer of the armor is good aligned and goes below -5 hit points, the armor casts a cure light wounds spell upon him the next round, as if cast by a 4th level cleric (1d8+4 hp). This miraculous healing only functions once, after which the armor permanently loses the ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cure light wounds, fire shield, resist energy; Cost: 15,000 gp.
